title: Pricing — valid row, stated quantity: two mould-affected window reveals
why: MOULD-REVEAL requires an evidenced count. The surveyor states two windows. The expected line is MOULD-REVEAL × 2 = £220–£320, quantity source 'stated'. Anything else is a pricing error.
